goal: Orchestrate multi-step reasoning, autonomous sub-query gap resolution, counterfactual critique, cross-artifact reconciliation, proactive copilot advisory, and closed-loop retrieval calibration across the 12-agent runtime mesh.

loop.observe: Inspect active stage state, RetrievalEvidencePacket coverage manifest, DecisionResult unknown criteria, QASwarm findings, or ConversationContextModel live turns.
loop.decide: Evaluate SSOT ambiguity margin (delta = c_top - c_second) and coverage gaps; select bounded specialist delegation or autonomous progression when delta > 0.20 and c_top >= 0.65.
loop.act: Dispatch contract-validated A2ATask with ClaimCheckPointer evidence references and Stable Prefix prompt structure to target specialist.
loop.evaluate: Verify specialist return payload against definition_of_done, check StagnationDetector progress delta, and enforce X1/C-19/UWG safety gates.

termination.success: All subquestions, decision criteria, or cross-artifact parity gates pass with verified source-bound citations and zero unapproved mutations.
termination.failure: Stagnation detected (zero coverage or score improvement across consecutive steps), budget exhausted, or fail-closed governance gate triggered.

budgets.time: 60s per specialist task (600s pipeline SLA ceiling)

resilience.retries: Max 2 bounded remediation retries with dynamic reasoning tier escalation (LOW -> MEDIUM -> HIGH -> XHIGH)
resilience.idempotency: SHA-256 idempotency_key on every A2ATask and digest-verified stage checkpoints
resilience.compensation: Non-destructive rollback to last verified stage checkpoint; propose-only fallback (approval_required=True, auto_apply=False)

approvals: Output 01 speaker attribution under diarization collapse (>85% single-speaker turn share)
escalations: Ambiguity margin delta <= 0.20 inclusive surfaced atomically via ask_user_question
Counterfactual Devil's Advocate falsification dropping option margin <= 0.20

observability.correlation: OpenTelemetry trace_id, session_id, attempt_id, and A2ATask correlation_id
